summary.value: On Halloween night a curtain drops over Shibuya and traps thousands of civilians inside. It is a trap built over years to take the strongest sorcerer, Satoru Gojo, out of the picture.
Teams of sorcerers go in, and each is pushed into fights they did not plan for. The incident changes the jujutsu world for good.

events.title: A traitor at Jujutsu High
events.detail: Utahime Iori takes the first-years to find the person leaking the school's secrets.

events.title: A curtain falls over Shibuya
events.detail: At 7 p.m. on 31 October, civilians are sealed in and Gojo is called in.

events.title: Gojo is sealed
events.detail: The enemy's plan to remove him works.

events.title: The station becomes a battlefield
events.detail: Sorcerers fight their way in while mutated people crowd the platforms.

events.title: Sukuna awakens
events.detail: A curse feeds Itadori several fingers at once, and Sukuna takes his body.
